notes.title: Pwnk V0.8.1 small update
notes.notes:
What's new
-When answering in chat, viewers don't need to input "!" before the answer. (Both with or without ! will work)
-Optimized the game intro, making it easier to understand
-Added 45 new questions in Pwnk Relations

Bug fixes
-Pwnk places picture doesn't load issue fixed
-Pwnk doll shuffle issue is mostly fixed
